papers.title: Rest-to-task transfer of sparse-to-full EEG reconstruction for cognitive-load decoding.
papers.reason: The paper uses EEG from an N-back working-memory task to evaluate cognitive-load decoding with sparse electrode reconstruction, making it relevant to task-based digital cognitive assessment despite being primarily a signal-reconstruction methods paper.

papers.title: Characterising semantic prioritisation in visual working memory
papers.reason: The paper centrally examines human visual working memory and attentional prioritisation using preregistered behavioural experiments and drift-diffusion modelling of decision processes.
